correctness.rationale: An explicit reachable carry/parity DFAO computes every input correctly. Residuals are distinct by a self-contained aperiodicity proof, so the automaton is minimal. Digit-layer intervals count every quotient/parity state without overlap, including six universal low states, all short shifts, and the extremal dyadic layers. The embedded verifier completed 4,096 finite minimizations, 98,208 direct input checks, 4,088 block extremizer checks and 300 large-shift checks; finite checks corroborate rather than establish the infinitely quantified theorem.

originality.rationale: Relevant primary full texts were compared at the level of input direction, actual sequence, numeration system, transform, quantified parameter range and implication. General operations bounds and the exact c=1 case do not give the full all-shift digit formula or exact extrema. The MSD-first shifted Thue–Morse table and the Zeckendorf Fibonacci result are inequivalent. Targeted indexed claims did not show dominating coverage. An unindexed source remains a priority risk, not a proof of novelty.
residual_risks: Possible unindexed earlier exact shifted binary 2-kernel enumeration despite no equivalent retrieved statement.
Some literature assumes only canonical numeral representations; the present theorem explicitly quantifies over all finite input words including trailing zeros.
Exhaustive publication priority and independent mathematical validation have not been established.

value.rationale: The full shifted \(2\)-kernel cardinality of the archetypal automatic sequence is a natural complexity invariant. The exact formula for every shift plus unique minima and \(2^{k-3}\) explicitly characterized maxima in each dyadic block captures nontrivial oscillation invisible in the known O(log c) framework. The result is not a one-off instance, renaming, parameter substitution or mere computation.
